$comment: Machine-readable record of what this fork was taken from, and of the boundary
time scripts/upstream-sync.mjs lands upstream work; leave `base` alone - it is a
measurement of the import, not a moving pointer.

modelNote: This repository does not share commit ancestry with upstream: the office
applications were ported in, not merged, so `git merge-base` against upstream
resolves to nothing. `base` below is therefore measured, not recorded by git,
and upstream work is taken file-by-file rather than by three-way merge.

base.subject: feat(ai-panels): RTL-aware chrome and auto-direction messages in slides/sheets/pdf/markdown (part of #13) (#203)
base.measuredBy: blob-hash set intersection between this tree and every upstream first-parent commit; the peak is the base. Path-keyed comparison is useless here because the port renamed directories, and a name-only diff is dominated by the brand sweep.
base.tieBreak: newest of the tied commits in upstream first-parent order, since the port landed 2026-09-06

importCommit.subject: Merge PR #34: Port GenOffice wholesale into Redrob + rhwp Hangul editing + Redrob AI engine

excludedReason: Upstream ships no separately-licensed directory (no ee/, no enterprise tree), so nothing is excluded. The list stays here so a future upstream split has one place to be recorded.

attribution.why: Apache-2.0 section 4(d) requires upstream's NOTICE content to travel with every distribution.
The fork stays under the same licence as upstream.
